entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say or enter your customer ID.
Thank you. Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. I see you're one of our VIP members, it's a pleasure to speak with you today. How can I help?
I need to return the VeloBand I just got.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference?
Preference. There was a family emergency.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I do hope everything is alright.

It's fine. My son's deployment got moved up, and then my husband had to be rushed to the hospital for an emergency surgery. The band was for him, but that's not happening now. I just want to return it.
Of course, I completely understand. My goodness, that is certainly a lot to handle at once. Let me make this as easy as possible. Can you confirm the delivery date for me?
Five days ago.
Thank you. Let me just check the official policy for you... one moment please.

Okay, yes, I'm looking at our knowledge base now, and I can confirm that all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it only five days ago, you are well within that window.
Fine. So you'll take it back?

Absolutely. I've just processed and approved the return for a full refund. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. And please, extend our very best wishes to your husband for a speedy recovery and to your son for his service.
Whatever. Just send the label.

The email is on its way. And as you are a valued VIP member, and given the extremely stressful situation you've been through, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for the trouble. It has no expiration.
Oh. Okay. Thank you.
You are most welcome. Is there anything else at all I can help you with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and please take care.
